findings.summary: The AC-4 test 'persistence line reads launchctl print' calls webhookPersistence(mkd(env, true)) and expects /^persisted: launchd com.ai-sdlc.webhook./. webhookPersistence does not pass a platform to forwarderPersistence, so the platform defaults to process.platform. On ubuntu-latest CI the function returns 'persisted: no (no launchd on this platform)' and the assertions fail. Fix: thread an optional platform parameter through webhookPersistence, as webhookUp already does, and pass 'darwin' in the test.

findings.summary: removeForwarder (and webhookPersistence at line 526) take the launchd label from feed.agent in the board-dir state file instead of a hardcoded constant. The value is not checked, so a tampered state file with feed.agent like '../../x' would make webhookDown run launchctl bootout on that label and rmSync a .plist file outside ~/Library/LaunchAgents. Hardening only. Suggestion: accept feed.agent only if it matches /^com\.ai-sdlc\.webhook\.[a-z0-9-]+$/, otherwise fall back to forwarderLabel(deps).
